routines.edgeAssessment: The subsecond two-record grids make the factor 1/radius observable in all three velocity components while exact shared-boundary and trimmed descriptors select the correct segment/record.
routines.errorAssessment: Nonpositive count gives NUMCOEFFSNOTPOS, invalid degree, interval, frame, bounds, coverage and identifier cases are terminal genuine SPICE errors. Wrong physical size, nonfinite input and closed/foreign token are separately checked as wrapper errors; same-writer recovery is exercised.

routines.fixtureRationale: Each side writes real files, then independent implementations consume the other writer’s emitted bytes. Test inputs require the built-in J2000 frame only.
routines.cleanup: Registered case lifecycle closes writer references, unloads kernels and clears scratch paths. Each terminal-error case seeds a valid segment so the writer can close. Public tests dispose clients in finally and delete authored OS scratch files. WASM fault tests verify four allocation failure points and same-handle recovery.
routines.tolerance: Error codes, descriptor fields/addresses, stored coefficient and trailer words, and returned identifiers are exact. State components use the existing registered comparator plus an independent, per-component analytic check at seven epochs to nine decimal places; no global tolerances change.
